title: ISKCON Temple Patna
tagline: Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari ISKCON Patna — The Grand 108-Pillar Marble Vedic Temple

heroImage.alt: ISKCON Temple Patna - Conch Building at ISKCON Temple, Mayapur, West Bengal, India.

overview.short: Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari ISKCON Temple on Budh Marg is Bihar’s largest and most magnificent modern Hindu temple, built in Rajasthani and South Indian marble architecture with 108 grand stone pillars.
overview.description: Inaugurated in May 2022, the 100-foot-tall ISKCON temple spans a 2-acre complex on Budh Marg near Patna Junction. The architectural masterpiece features pristine Makrana white marble, 84 intricately carved pillars depicting Lord Krishna’s pastimes, a 1,000-person prayer darbar hall, Govinda’s multi-cuisine restaurant, and a Vedic cultural museum.
features: Buddha Smriti Park & Patna Museum Corridor
overview.about: A grand modern spiritual oasis vibrating with ecstatic Hare Krishna Mahamantra kirtans, delicious prasadam, and exquisite Rajasthani marble artistry.

howToReach.roadNote: Located on Budh Marg in the heart of Patna, walking distance from Patna Junction railway station.

topPlaces.name: Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Main Sanctum
topPlaces.description: Breathtaking white marble sanctum housing the deities of Radha Banke Bihari, Gaur Nitai, and Ram Darbar.

image.alt: Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Main Sanctum in ISKCON Temple Patna, Bihar

topPlaces.name: 108 Sculpted Marble Pillars & Darbar Hall
topPlaces.description: 108 monumental Makrana marble pillars intricately carved with Bhagavad Gita and Krishna Leela stories.

image.alt: 108 Sculpted Marble Pillars & Darbar Hall - Jal Mandir - Pawapuri

topPlaces.name: Buddha Smriti Park & Patliputra Karuna Stupa
topPlaces.description: 22-acre urban memorial park featuring a 200-foot stupa housing authentic Lord Buddha relics.

image.alt: Buddha Smriti Park & Patliputra Karuna Stupa - Jal Mandir - Pawapuri

topPlaces.name: Patna Museum (Jadu Ghar Heritage)
topPlaces.description: Mughal-Rajput architectural museum opened in 1917, housing a 200-million-year-old fossilized tree and holy Buddha relics casket.

image.alt: Patna Museum (Jadu Ghar Heritage) - Jal Mandir - Pawapuri

topPlaces.name: Mahavir Mandir (Patna Junction Hanuman Temple)
topPlaces.description: One of the most visited Hanuman temples in North India, famous for twin Hanuman idols and Naivedyam laddoos.

image.alt: Mahavir Mandir (Patna Junction Hanuman Temple) in ISKCON Temple Patna, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Golghar Granary & Circular Vista
topPlaces.description: Iconic 1786 stupa-shaped colonial granary offering panoramic views of the city and the Ganga.

image.alt: Golghar Granary & Circular Vista - Jal Mandir - Pawapuri

topPlaces.name: Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park (Patna Zoo)
topPlaces.description: 153-acre lush botanical and zoological park renowned for successful breeding of one-horned Indian rhinoceroses.

image.alt: Sanjay Gandhi Biological Park (Patna Zoo) in ISKCON Temple Patna, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Eco Park (Rajdhani Vatika)
topPlaces.description: Vibrant 9-hectare ecological park featuring two central lakes, walking trails, and themed flower gardens.

image.alt: Eco Park (Rajdhani Vatika) in ISKCON Temple Patna, Bihar
